memory.rule: Treat user corrections as immutable source-of-truth updates.
Adapt strategies instantly without prompt reminders.

physics.rule: DRY: Threshold = 3 files. If code exists in >=3 files, extract to global component/utility.
Bundle: Dynamic imports (next/dynamic) for heavy/below-the-fold elements.
Strict TS: No 'any'. No hardcoded mock leaks in production commits.
Accessibility: All body text must sustain a >= 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Set background to var(--color-off-white) and force text to var(--foreground) [#0f172a] to guarantee a sharp 18.7:1 ratio.

architecture.layer: Abstract all state, side-effects, and fetch calls into custom hooks/services.

seo_and_a11y.metric: Prioritize Next.js Image component over raw img. Apply priority flags for above-the-fold assets to eliminate loading bottlenecks.
Break up heavy JS execution using next/dynamic chunking and run complex UI side-effects inside isolated custom hooks to free the main thread.

semantic_rules.rule: Enforce strict structural hierarchy: a single, unique h1 per page, sequential headings (h2 then h3), and self-descriptive aria-labels for all interactive components.
Variable naming must be highly descriptive and self-documenting; avoid cryptic short hands to keep the engineering architecture transparent.

execution.intent: Scan for bottlenecks, contrast failures, bundle bloat, and P1 violations.
Pixel-perfect replication using Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui structural primitives matching high-contrast targets.
Scale logic via hooks without leaking into the UI layer.
